conclusions: Independent verifier pins both original seals, the matrix, original packer and fixture-record identities. It traverses the sealed inventory and accepted native outputs, enforces directory/case sets and fixed totals, reconstructs every data/header/numeric projection and checks typed JSON values including signed zero. Original inputs and final fixture bytes are rehashed after comparison.

The three-shard unicode-arbitrary-names-vocab regression mutates all three foreign path buffers and all three pointer slots on the first callback. It would detect a future implementation that copied only the primary path before invoking callbacks.
Production split_path.rs and model.rs differ from the previously reviewed versions only by rustfmt layout and optional trailing commas. No production behavior changes.
Measured x86_64 Windows/MSVC and Linux/GNU parent-module target gating is retained; the child test is now a regular path module traversed by rustfmt.
